no: See Johan Meyer, Michael de Villiers and Peter Moses, `euclid 7714 <https://groups.io/g/euclid/message/7714>`__.

For a generalization, let t be any angle and D the point with trilinears csc(A + t) : : in triangle ABC. Let A' be the point with trilinears csc(A - t) : : in triangle DBC, and define B' and C' cyclically. Then AA', BB', CC' concur in the point having trilinears [1 / (y(B,A,C) y(C,A,B)) + 1 / (y(B,A,C) y(C,B,A)) + 1 / (y(B,C,A) y(C,A,B))] / (sin(B - t) csc(B + t) + sin(C - t) csc(C + t) + 2) : : , where y(A,B,C) = sin(t) csc(A + t) - sin(B - t) csc(C + t).
